integrity: The source-height classification is prior and explicitly credited. The generating function, coefficient sequence, and asymptotic density are the claims reviewed here. Finite exhaustive computation is used only as verification, not as proof of the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: The count is for labeled unary operations. The originality search leaves residual risk of an equivalent enumeration under older functional-digraph terminology; no unlabeled enumeration is claimed.
